topic: Adjusting data insertion logic for reports
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on discrepancies in how model data is inserted into reports, specifically regarding the relationship between facility sessions and frame data. Previously, even without facility sessions, model data was always included for frames. Since April 24th, this automatic insertion of data when no facility session existed has been disabled.

This change causes situations where a record exists for a frame but not for its associated facility in the report data (which is aggregated).

Two potential fixes were proposed:
1. Do not use the frame model if there are no sessions on its facility; this would reduce campaign impressions in the report.
2. Partially restore the data insertion when sessions are missing, while circumventing the original problem that led to the disabling of 'clean' model insertion; this would increase campaign impressions in the report.
decisions: The specific cause for disabling the 'clean' model data insertion is unknown and requires further recall.
action_items: Reviewing the impact of the proposed fixes on reporting metrics (campaign vs. facility impressions).
